_comment: Static model registry for routing. Intelligence and coding index values were seeded once from the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index / Coding Agent Index (Aug 2026) — treat them as settled; do not re-verify per task. Edit by hand when you deliberately update scores. Live signals (quota, load, observed tok/s) are merged by `bus models` at read time.

models.label: Claude Opus 5
models.intelligence_index_source: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, Aug 2026 (max reasoning)
models.quota: claude plan; no local API — /usage in Claude Code TUI
models.notes: UI/design/artistic judgment and planning agents per orchestration preferences. AA Coding Index ~78.0, essentially tied with Sol. On Paseo 0.7.0 (2026-09-28) claude-opus-5-5 silently fell back to claude-opus-5; Paseo 0.17.4 (2026-11-23) serves claude/claude-opus-5-5 directly (pinned below).

models.label: Claude Opus 5.5
models.quota: claude plan; no local API — /usage in Claude Code TUI
models.notes: 2026-11-23 canary on Paseo 0.17.4: `paseo run --provider claude --model claude-opus-5-5 --thinking high` inspected as Provider claude, Model claude-opus-5-5, Thinking high, and answered OPUS55-OK. Used as the offline fallback pin for the highest-Opus (`any_major: true`) non-Claude-orchestrator code-agent default in brood-swarm/agents.json.

models.label: GPT-6 Sol
models.intelligence_index_source: 6-series not measured here; prior-release August 2026 scores are retained in _previous_release_measurements
models.quota: codex plan; live rate-limit windows read from codex rollouts
models.notes: 2026-11-06: Sol 6.1 is the default code author at high (agents.json); this registry keeps the prior 6-series dispatch spelling. Orchestrator canary inspected Provider codex, Model gpt-6.1-sol, Thinking high, and answered SOL61-OK. Sol keeps deep review at xhigh with author exclusion; Astra takes tiebreak and concurrence. Prior-release scores remain dated history.

_previous_release_measurements.notes: Integration/review gate in sprints. AA Coding Index 78.3, leads Opus by a hair.

models.notes: 2026-11-06: deep reviewer, committee tiebreak and mandate concurrence party at xhigh. Leaves planning because its tiebreak seat must not rule among its own committee members.
